io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.storage.backend.migration

Class MigrationService

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.storage.backend.migration.MigrationService

  • @Beta
public class MigrationService
extends java.lang.Object
    One-time, per-world migration of the flat-file (.sfb/.sfc/.sfi) block storage into a JdbcBackend. Idempotent via storage_meta flags: once a world (or the universal inventories) has been migrated, the flat data is renamed to a .migrated-backup-<bootTimestamp> sibling and never touched again.

    Any failure during a migration leaves the flat files completely intact (no flag, no rename) so the next boot simply retries - zero data loss on a partial/failed run.

    This API is still experimental, it may change without notice.

        public void migratePlayerDataIfNeeded(@Nonnull
                                      JdbcStorage playerStore)
        One-time import of the flat-file player data (Players/*.yml + waypoints/*.yml) into the JdbcStorage player store. Idempotent via a storage_meta flag in the block DB (both DBs only exist together in a JDBC backend). On success the two flat directories are renamed to .migrated-backup-<ts> siblings; any failure keeps them intact and retries next boot.
